title: Collections Desk Guidance — Agency Recall and Return to Active on the Patient Financial Account
content:
## Recall from the agency

A Patient Financial Account in collections is recalled from the agency and returned to active in any of these cases:

| Event | Recalled |
|---|---|
| the placed balance is paid in full | yes |
| a late insurance payment reduces the placed balance, on a class that recalls on late insurance payment | yes |
| the placement is found to be in error — a charge on hold, a charge enrolled in an active payment plan, or a charge covered by a later hardship approval | yes |

A partial payment to an account in collections, however large, does not by itself recall it.

## Clause no longer in force

The clause under which an account in precollection returned to active when its past-due balance was enrolled in a payment plan or paid below the placement minimum is no longer in force and has been superseded by the current basis. The placement minimum remains the figure of each financial class.

## Effect of recall and return to active

Recall and return to active clear the placement date and the final-notice date on the account, and the statement series restarts at 1 for any balance still owed.

**Hypothetical illustration.** An account placed with the agency with a balance of 420.00 receives a payment of 400.00: it stays in collections. When the remaining 20.00 is paid, the placed balance is paid in full, the account is recalled and returned to active, its placement and final-notice dates are cleared, and — having no balance left — it has no statement series to restart.

superseded_clauses: An account in precollection returns to active when its past-due balance is enrolled in a payment plan or paid below collections_min_balance_usd.
